title: Pick the class for the policy wiki
prompt: The wiki has 38,400 pages with HTML bodies, a paginated API, a synchronous HTTP client, and group-based ACLs. What do you build?

options.text: An async streaming connector; identities take care of themselves.
options.feedback: Async streaming implementations also skip get_identities(). Without identities, the ACLs match nobody.

options.text: BasePeopleConnector, because the ACLs depend on people.
options.feedback: BasePeopleConnector produces employee records, which are distinct from the datasource identities that back ACLs.

options.text: A streaming connector, plus a separate step that pushes users, groups, and memberships first.
options.feedback: Right. Large, paginated, synchronous: streaming. Streaming connectors do not run get_identities(), so identities are pushed separately, before content.

takeaway: Choosing streaming means owning the identity push.
